0.original: Vuyargur wishes to welcome Pelupelu patrons up the mountain.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Speak with the Yok Huy mountain guide in Worlar's Echo.

2.original: Deliver the requested item to the intrepid hiker.

24.original: Speak with the Yok Huy mountain guide in Worlar's Echo.

48.original: Great news, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Nopli tells me no few Pelupelu wish to visit Zirgorteh the Open-armed.

49.original: I inquired with Fahrafahr, and she agrees that our beautiful altar ought to live on in the memories of any and all who would behold it.

50.original: Do you recall that mountaineering paraphernalia you made for us? Well, it seems word of mouth has attracted more prospective hikers from Wachunpelo.

51.original: Worlar's Echo is preparing to receive them, but they require the aid of an artisan, and I'd like to send you.

52.original: When you arrive, speak to the mountain guide for your assignment. Safe travels!

53.original: I'm told you'll be providing me with the equipment I need to make the climb. I shall expect your very best work!

54.original: The moment I heard about Zirgorteh the Open-armed, I knew I had to see it for myself. For that, I'll need to gear up!

55.original: Thank you for coming down, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. This merchant placed an order with me, but I find I'm struggling to craft equipment for such small frames.

56.original: To complete this set of mountaineering paraphernalia, could you craft a pair of goggles to shield the eyes from the biting winds?

57.original: To complete this set of mountaineering paraphernalia, could you craft a pair of small-yet-sturdy snowshoes?

58.original: To complete this set of mountaineering paraphernalia, could you prepare a serving of rations to be stored in an insulated container?

59.original: In return, I'll furnish you with the materials you require. Say the word if you run short.

60.original: By all means, deliver the completed set directly to our Pelu friend here.

63.original: Having some trouble? I understand completely. Take these.

66.original: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.

67.original: Oh, I can't wait to see what you've made for me!

68.original: How did it go? Can I see it yet?

69.original: A worthy investment of coin, if I do say so myself. So long as I have this, I need fear no icy mountain trail!

70.original: The rumors don't do you justice, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I can but admire your craftsmanship.

71.original: Now then, let us begin the long climb!

72.original: Great work, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. A fully outfitted Pelupelu passed by just now, chatting pleasantly with the mountain guide on their way to the Breathless Altar.

73.original: Should anyone else take an interest in Zirgorteh the Open-armed, I hope we can count on you again.
